landing.name: Emely García
landing.phrase: Designing, developing, and maintaining scalable, high-performance web applications.

experience.title: My Experience
experience.description:
Hey, I'm a Front-End Developer with almost 5 years of experience.
I love building fast, scalable web apps that look and feel great.
I'm comfortable working with React, Angular, and modern web tools.
I've worked with Agile teams from different parts of the world, such as India, the United States, and Canada.
Clean code, testing, and performance are super important to me.

items.description:
As a designer and web developer, Led the design and development of a POS system for small and medium businesses.
Built key features for a hybrid mobile app and helped connect it across platforms.

As an Angular developer, I worked to create dynamic, business-focused UI layouts with top-notch usability and responsive design.
Built clean, reusable code with a strong focus on quality and scalability.
Delivered updates constantly, following continuous delivery best practices.

As a Senior Frontend Developer I had the chance to work at WOTDev and Quickplay, leading and developing projects for OTT platforms.
I focused on making streaming experiences smooth and fast for web and SmartTV apps.
Designed clean, high-performing interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular and React.
Built and maintained SDKs to help different clients easily connect to the platforms.
Worked hands-on with Agile teams to drive projects forward and deliver great results.

I currently work as a React Developer at Elaniin, contributing to a large-scale government project alongside a team of more than 10 collaborators, delivering a robust and scalable web solution.

My role focuses on building high-performance, maintainable user interfaces using React, TypeScript, and modern frontend technologies, translating business requirements and design specifications into efficient, reusable components. I actively work on performance optimization, API integration, and ensuring a smooth, responsive user experience. I collaborate closely with designers, product managers, and engineers in an Agile environment, participating in code reviews, continuous improvements, and the adoption of best practices.

quote.author: Steve Jobs
quote.text: The only way to do great work is to love what you do.

engineering.subtitle: ENGINEERING APPROACH
engineering.title: Building systems that stay maintainable.
engineering.description: Every project is designed with scalability, readability, and long-term ownership in mind. Beyond shipping features, I focus on architecture decisions, performance, and developer experience to ensure software remains reliable as requirements evolve.

cta.title: Interested in working together?
cta.description: Whether you're building a product from scratch, improving an existing platform, or exploring new technical ideas, I'm always open to discuss new challenges.
